bio: If you miss the warmth of Italy, make a beeline for this stylish Venetian eatery (with a splendid wine cellar) and take a seat on the charming patio. The bread, pasta and desserts are all the handiwork of the mistress of the house, who fusses over diners like a real Italian mamma! The chef’s northern Italy delicacies range from vitello alla Milanese to pheasant risotto and sign a declaration of love to all foodies!...
